description: Defines the data structures and preview instances for OpenClaw activity attributes used by an iOS app and a Live Activity widget extension, including nested state representations and debug preview data.

classes.name: OpenClawActivityAttributes
classes.description: A structure conforming to ActivityAttributes, representing shared activity data with nested ContentState for live activity status.

classes.name: OpenClawActivityAttributes.ContentState
classes.description: A nested Codable and Hashable structure capturing the current activity status details.

methods.name: preview
methods.description: Provides a static preview instance of OpenClawActivityAttributes for debugging or UI previews.

methods.name: connecting
methods.description: Predefined ContentState instance representing a connecting state.

methods.name: idle
methods.description: Predefined ContentState instance representing an idle state.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Predefined ContentState instance representing a disconnected state.
